description: This file defines the ClusterConfig interface and its nested enum ClusterConfigValue, providing configuration settings for a Ditto cluster, including methods for accessing the number of shards and the roles to exclude from cluster status calculations.

classes.name: ClusterConfig
classes.description: An interface that provides configuration methods for a Ditto cluster, including retrieving the number of shards and roles blocklist.

classes.name: ClusterConfig.ClusterConfigValue
classes.description: An enum implementing KnownConfigValue, defining configuration path expressions and default values for cluster settings.

methods.name: getNumberOfShards
methods.description: Returns the number of shards in a cluster.

methods.name: getClusterStatusRolesBlocklist
methods.description: Returns the collection of cluster roles to exclude when checking cluster status/health.

methods.name: getConfigPath
methods.description: Returns the configuration path string associated with the enum value.

methods.name: getDefaultValue
methods.description: Returns the default value associated with the enum value.
